open-1.text: Somewhere tonight, a Marine is finishing work that no one will ever see.

detail-1.text: Thirty reconciliations. A funding gap, caught in time.

scatter-1.text: By morning, most of it is gone.

scatter-2.text: Into a spreadsheet. An inbox. Somebody’s memory.

capture-1.text: Say what you did, once. Vantage reads the numbers, and shows you before it saves.

queue-1.text: Your section’s work, in one queue. Claim it, and it’s yours.

case-1.text: Cases follow cited procedures. Evidence before action. Resolved only when verified.

balance-2.text: Read in the order the money moves.

sealed-1.text: Every entry, signed into the history. Nothing important happens quietly.

credit-1.text: And the credit goes to the Marine who did the work.

report-1.text: When evaluation season comes, the record is already written, and every line cites its source.

lead-1.text: Leaders see the whole section at a glance.

trust-1.text: Private by default. Built to run on your own network.

end-1.text: Vantage. Give good work a lasting record.

ql-1.text: The fastest way to keep a record. Press N, anywhere in Vantage.

ql-2.text: Write it the way you’d say it out loud.

ql-3.text: Vantage reads the count, the dollar value and what kind of value it is, the system, and the date.

ql-4.text: Check what it understood, then save. It lands in your record, dated, and yours.

ql-5.text: No signal? It waits on your device, and syncs when you’re back.

q-1.text: Work arrives as a queue your whole section can see.

q-2.text: Claim a case, and it’s on your list at once. Claiming isn’t credit. The work is.

q-3.text: The procedure shows the next step, and the form asks only for what that step needs.

q-4.text: Record what you found, and Vantage calculates the candidate, citing every input.

q-5.text: Decide, with your reason. A step that needs evidence first says so, before it refuses.

q-6.text: Every entry is signed into the history. Hand it on, and each of you keeps exactly what you did.

b-1.text: The Reference is the FMRA desk reference, inside Vantage, with every statement cited.

b-2.text: Enter a document’s commitment, obligation, delivered, and paid.

b-3.text: Vantage names the open condition, the causes worth ruling out, who can act, and what would prove the fix.

b-4.text: A dash on a report isn’t a zero. Mark it not shown.

b-5.text: Open a case, and the figures come with it, labelled with where they came from.

r-1.text: It keeps three things apart. What you hold, which isn’t credit. What you contributed, counted from the work itself. And what you logged yourself.

r-2.text: One document counts once, however many entries it took.

r-3.text: From any case you worked, prepare a private draft, built only from your own facts.

r-4.text: Keep it, and it lands in your record, with a link back to the case.

s-1.text: Report Studio turns your record into JEPES or FITREP input.

s-2.text: Choose the period, and the entries it should cite.

s-3.text: Write against facts you can open and check.

s-4.text: Save, and the revision is locked to exactly what was reviewed.

l-1.text: As a section lead, Today puts your section first: what’s unassigned, overdue, blocked, and waiting, and on what.

l-2.text: See how many open commitments, undelivered orders and UMTs you’re carrying.

l-3.text: Workload shows who holds what, beside what each count means.

l-4.text: Counts never measure effort. And zero recorded is never zero work.
